topic: The D.C. mayor caught in an FBI sting

beats.narration: In 1990, D.C. mayor Marion Barry was powerful—and federal agents were watching.

shots.scene_description: Mayor leaving city hall while investigators watch from an unmarked car

beats.narration: Investigators arranged a hotel meeting with a cooperating witness.

shots.scene_description: Mayor arriving at a 1990s hotel entrance for a secret meeting

beats.narration: Inside, they quietly placed a hidden camera in the room.

shots.scene_description: Investigator concealing a tiny camera inside a bedside lamp

beats.narration: Barry arrived, and the conversation shifted toward drugs.

shots.scene_description: Mayor greeting a cooperating witness at a hotel table

beats.narration: The surveillance camera kept recording every tense second.

shots.scene_description: Close view of surveillance lamp recording a tense hotel conversation, no drug use shown

beats.narration: Then federal agents rushed in and arrested the sitting mayor.

shots.scene_description: Federal agents entering hotel room as mayor stands with hands visible

beats.narration: The arrest footage spread across television news almost immediately.

shots.scene_description: Reporters and television cameras gathering outside the hotel after the arrest

beats.narration: Barry was later convicted on a cocaine-possession charge.

shots.scene_description: Courthouse steps and legal papers suggesting a conviction, no readable text

beats.narration: He served six months in prison, and many thought his career was over.

shots.scene_description: Prison cell door closing on a distant silhouette behind iron bars

beats.narration: But voters elected him mayor again, turning scandal into an extraordinary comeback.

shots.scene_description: Political comeback rally with fictionalized public official stepping onto a stage as Washington supporters cheer
